'''Notasha''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].

== Activities ==
She was injured while battling during the [[Battle of Tar Valon]] and was [[Heal]]ed at some stage. 

She, along with two other Red sister, accompanies [[Katerine Alruddin]] when Katerine tries to replace [[Saerin Asnobar]] as the Aes Sedai in charge of the resistance within the lower levels of the [[White Tower]].
